intent: User selected Studio but rejects its plainness and lack of visible animation. Enrich the interactive prototype using original ChatFullPage.jsx, not production migration.

features: Image/doc upload, drag/drop and pasted images

productConstraints: No live AI or API request
Demo and sample attribution stay visible
Do not claim image/video/audio generation: those category prototypes edit and export a brief, not fabricate a generation result
Only self-hosted existing fonts and local assets
Do not change Atlas, Signal, source React or backend

motion.focalMoment: A bounded authored Studio engine: aligned cobalt planes assemble around an UltrAI core while a task becomes a demo answer; replay and pause controls, six-second maximum autoplay.
motion.continuity: Category active rail, model picker, expandable history, message arrival, and light/dark states transition without discarding user input.
motion.feedback: Streaming a stored example has a visible stop action and status; attachment arrival/removal and copy acknowledge action.
motion.budget: CSS/WAAPI only, no new dependency; pause all nonessential motion when hidden/offscreen; respect reduced motion; never hide useful content behind animation.

layout.landing: Keep Studio white/navy/cobalt, Manrope/DM Sans. Add an actual animated product mechanism and replay, strengthen workbench state transitions; preserve content and two user journeys.
layout.workspace: Real application shell: dark-navy contextual sidebar beside a calm light canvas; compact topbar with searchable model picker and theme switch. An authored Studio mark, large two-tone greeting, a four-mode action rail, substantial composer with files, and compact useful prompt tiles. Conversation mode retains composer and shows role, model attribution, code block and copy/stop actions. No fake online badge or invented metrics.
layout.mobile: Keep composer and model choices visible without wide header; sidebar as expandable region; picker constrained to viewport with focus containment; controls at least12px and44px touch targets where practical.

ownership.Main: index.html, gallery selection, preview metadata, server allowlist, motion.js, browser verification
ownership.Engine: app.js only; existing workspace functions and event handlers cleanly upgraded, console retained
ownership.Presentation: style.css only; replace workspace styling and old conflicting responsive workspace rules, preserve console and landing grammar

previewValidation: Landing motion at t0/t1/t3 and pause/replay
Workspace model search/group choice, empty search, Escape
Theme and sidebar preserve unsent draft
Chat submit streams demo, stop stable, copy
File chooser/drop/paste accepts allowed types and enforces5/20MiB
Image/video/audio mode shows honest brief workflow
Console preserved, gallery full-size route current
